props.title: Chelsey Webb
props.face: Covers and originals, as a duo or with a full band.
props.lede: You know that feeling when the fiddle kicks in on a country song you love? Chelsey Webb is a Denver country singer raised in Alabama, with a big, soulful voice and just enough outlaw spirit, and she plays country, rock and pop covers alongside her own songs. You can book her as a duo, or bring her full band, fiddle and all, when you want people dancing.
props.headingNote: Here’s how booking through Signet works.

props.title: Chelsey Webb and her band playing a dance medley into Here for the Party, live
Awards and press
props.pressTitle: In the press and on air

props.html: Chelsey was named Female Entertainer of the Year at the 2025 Colorado Country Music Hall of Fame awards, and The Denver Gazette covered the night. She’s played Cheyenne Frontier Days, the Greeley Stampede, the National Western Stock Show, the Grizzly Rose and the Copper Mountain Country Music Festival, and she’s shared the stage with Tracy Byrd, Jackson Dean, Corey Kent and Wyatt Flores, too.

She grew up in Alabama singing along to the family jukebox and Southern gospel, and she’s recorded in Nashville at Omni Studios. She names Shania Twain, Faith Hill, Dolly Parton, Stevie Nicks and Janis Joplin among the singers who shaped her smoky, soulful voice.

Along with the covers, Chelsey writes and records her own songs. Two of her 2025 releases, Look What I Found and Blue Side of Lonesome, are songs her family wrote in the 1990s, and she brought them back to life with her husband.

props.title: Configurations
props.note: Send us your date and we’ll help you choose the size that works best. She can bring a band somewhere in between, too.

rows.text: Book the duo for your cocktail hour, then bring in the full band for the reception when you want people dancing.
Chelsey plays a lot of fairs, rodeos and outdoor stages, so a big summer party in the backyard suits her band well.
The duo is an easy fit for a party at home, and the full band is a blast for a milestone birthday when your friends love country music.
Her song list runs from Brooks & Dunn to Sabrina Carpenter, so there’s something for a mixed crowd, and the full band gets people dancing.

props.html: Planning toasts or a program? We can work the music around them with your run of show. You can also get a general idea of what live music costs in Colorado from our cost guide.

items.q: Does Chelsey Webb play covers or her own songs?
items.a: She plays both. Her song list mixes country, rock and pop covers with songs of her own, and we’ll put the setlist together with you.

items.q: Can the volume stay down during dinner?
items.a: Yes. The duo can play at a level where nobody has to raise their voice, and the full band is the one to bring when it’s time to dance. If your venue has a sound limit, just let us know.
